verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of the transfer-in process, EPP/auth-code flow, status tracking, transfer pricing, or handling of remaining registration time — only unrelated API/RDAP snippets and general community sentiment. One community comment (namecheap-comm-11) mentions an EPP code transfer failure, but this reflects a support friction anecdote, not documentation of the process, and does not establish that Namecheap publishes an honest transfer-in guide.
